title: Synchronization of shared lists gets broken too often
body:
We tried to use this app as a shared shopping list. At the first glance, all works. But over 2 months of usage synchronization got completely broken several times, so we ended up having 2 different sets of items in the list. Even after several days list wasn't synchronized.
So we switched back to Microsoft To Do for shared shopping list.
